title: 第2171章 希伯来偷懒第2170章 姑父的信件
content_zh:
光辉历9813年10月12日，贝尔德递交申请，维林签署命令，新的行政制度正式在特莱亚行省试点实施。
10月25日，特莱亚行省首府特莱亚城总督府内，上百名官员站在两侧，等候大总管。
针对祈星西区的大清洗，特莱亚行省作为引发这次大清洗的核心区域，被清查最为彻底。
贪污金币在一百到一千之间，降职发配边缘地区。
贪污金币在一千到一万之间，革除官职，罚做苦役十年。
贪污金币在一万到十万之间，罚做苦役五十年。
贪污金币在十万以上，允许自裁，以死谢罪。
短短几个月，特莱亚行省十三个郡五十二名主政一方的官员，十五人自杀，十一人被罚作苦役，八人被调往边缘地方，仅有十八人得以幸免。
至于特莱亚行省总督，有失察的职责，因其本人没有问题，只是象征性罚没半年的薪资。
大厅左侧第一个位置上，诺克图斯闭目养神，心中构思等会儿如何向大总管汇报特莱亚行省的实际情况。
他曾经与凯尔大人同为农奴，与伊登大人同为祈星领建军之初的老兵，当过多修斯大人的传令官，也在奥兰多大人手下担任过书记官，在拉海尔大人手下担任红茶树种植园守备官，也在贝尔德大总管麾下担任过行政官。
他是光辉历9702年出生，与领主大人出生于同一年。
今年一百一十一岁，实力已是黄金中阶战士。
他在祈星领之中默默无闻，没有耀眼的战绩，也没有令他人惊叹的实力，有的只是踏实做事，最终有了今天的成就。
“贝尔德大人到！”
诺克图斯睁开双眼，侧身面向大门处，右手抚胸行礼。
其余同样侧身行礼，向这位兼管祈星西区与祈星东区大总管表达自己的敬意。
来到主位上，贝尔德挥手示意众人起身，随后坐了下来。
环顾四周，与一年前来这里视察相比，多了很多生面孔。
“废话我不多说，这次我来特莱亚行省，目的只有一个，推行新的行政制度，在试行过程中根据出现的问题增补相应规章制度。”

“在这一年内，我允许你们在新的行政体系下绞尽脑汁去钻空子，为你们自己谋取利益。”
“但要是谁踩着底线去谋利，那就不要怪我的刀太快。”
大多数人听到这话，都下意识低下了头。
这话有奉旨贪污的意思，但具体界限却很模糊。
为了保住性命，他们选择按规矩办事，发现漏洞及时上报；亦或者让下面人去做，出事之后，他们最多有个失察的职责。
对于这些人在想什么，贝尔德一清二楚，但他话已经挑明，该怎么做是这些人的事情，自己只需要担任旁观者，根据出现的情况，完善这份行省级别的行政机构规章制度。
“诺克图斯。”
诺克图斯听到自己的名字，走出队列，来到大厅中央，右手抚胸，向贝尔德行礼道：“属下在。”
“现在由你来讲解一下特莱亚行省基本情况。”
“是。”
诺克图斯直起身来，随即开口说道：“截至今年八月，特莱亚行省人口有两千一百三十七万七千五百二十三人，相比于去年总人口增长了三十七万六千三百八十五人。”
content_en:
On October 12, 9813 in the Glorious Calendar, Baird submitted an application, Verin signed an order, and the new administrative system was officially implemented on a trial basis in the province of Traia.
On October 25, in the Governor's Palace of Teleia City, the capital of Teleia Province, hundreds of officials stood on both sides, waiting for the Grand Governor.
In response to the great purge in the Western District of Qi Xing, the province of Traia, as the core area that triggered this great purge, was the most thoroughly investigated.
The amount of gold coins embezzled is between one hundred and one thousand, and they will be demoted and distributed to marginal areas.
Those who embezzle between one thousand and ten thousand gold coins will be dismissed from their official positions and sentenced to ten years of hard labor.
Those who embezzle between 10,000 and 100,000 gold coins will be punished with fifty years of hard labor.
Those who embezzle more than 100,000 gold coins are allowed to commit suicide and die as an apology.
In just a few months, of the 52 officials in charge of the 13 counties of Trea Province, 15 committed suicide, 11 were sentenced to hard labor, 8 were transferred to marginal areas, and only 18 survived.
As for the Governor of Traia Province, he had neglected his duties because he had no problem with him and was only given a symbolic forfeiture of half a year's salary.
Sitting on the first seat on the left side of the hall, Noctus closed his eyes and rested, thinking about how to report the actual situation of the province of Traia to the Grand Steward later.
He was once a serf with Lord Kyle, and a veteran with Lord Iden at the beginning of the Qing Star Territory's army. He served as Lord Dorsius's herald, and also served as secretary under Lord Orlando, as garrison officer of the black tea tree plantation under Lord Rahel, and as administrator under Lord Steward Baird.
He was born in the year 9702 of the Glorious Calendar, the same year as the lord.
He is one hundred and eleven years old this year and is already a gold mid-level warrior.
He is unknown in the Qixing Leader. He has no dazzling achievements and no strength that amazes others. Instead, he just works hard and finally achieves what he has achieved today.
"Lord Baird is here!"
Noctus opened his eyes, turned sideways to face the door, put his right hand on his chest and saluted.
The others also bowed sideways to express their respect to the general manager in charge of Qi Xing West District and Qi Xing East District.
Arriving at the main seat, Baird waved for everyone to get up, and then sat down.
Looking around, there are many more new faces than when I came here for inspection a year ago.
"I won't talk nonsense. This time I came to Teleia Province for only one purpose, which is to implement a new administrative system and add corresponding rules and regulations according to the problems that arise during the trial implementation."
"During this year, I allow you to rack your brains to exploit loopholes under the new administrative system and seek benefits for yourself."
"But if anyone steps on the bottom line to make profits, then don't blame my knife for being too fast."
When most people heard this, they lowered their heads subconsciously.
This word has the meaning of corruption by decree, but the specific boundaries are very vague.
In order to save their lives, they choose to act according to the rules and report loopholes in a timely manner; or they can let the people below do it. After an accident, they will at most have the responsibility of oversight.
Baird knew exactly what these people were thinking, but his words had already made it clear that it was their business to do what they should do. He only needed to be a bystander and improve the rules and regulations of the provincial-level administrative agency based on the situation that emerged.
"Noctus."
When Noctus heard his name, he walked out of the queue and came to the center of the hall. He put his right hand on his chest and saluted Baird: "My subordinate is here."
"Now it's up to you to explain the basic situation of Teleia Province."
"Yes."
Noctus straightened up and immediately said: "As of August this year, the population of Traia Province was 21,377,523 people, an increase of 376,385 people compared to last year."
